name: Nine Whys
deliverable: Progressive conversational excavation of intrinsic organizational purpose

steps.text: Pair people; one describes a project they care about and why it matters to them.
Ask 'Why does that matter?' of each answer, following the chain through nine whys.
Switch roles and state the purpose you reached.

failure: The partner accepts a general answer like 'because it matters,' and the chain stalls at a slogan.
intervention: Ask once more: 'Why does that matter to you, specifically?' Then wait out the silence before moving on.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
